sources.entry: Mylar3 - Automated Comic Book (cbr/cbz) downloader program for use with NZB and torrents. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: Mylar3 is an automated comic book downloader that monitors watchlisted series and weekly pull-lists, then grabs, sorts, and renames issues from NZB and torrent sources.
summary.what_it_does: Mylar lets you build a watchlist of comic series that it checks for new issues and updated information. It downloads matching issues through NZB indexers and torrent clients, then sorts and renames them according to configurable rules. It can also monitor weekly pull-lists for items belonging to watchlisted series, and track story arcs. Downloaded issues can be meta-tagged using a modified version of ComicTagger, and it can generate series.json files for third-party applications. Notifications are sent on snatches and downloads.
use_cases: automatically download new comic book issues
download comics from NZB or torrent sources
rename and sort comic book files
how_to_run: git clone the repository and run it with Python
notable: Community continuity fork of the original Mylar project
Supports SABnzbd, NZBGet, various torrent clients and Blackhole
Built-in metatagging via a modified ComicTagger
Generates series.json files for third-party apps
Story arc tracking and pull-list monitoring
caveats: README says TPB and GN are supported for monitoring and post-processing but not import at present
Documentation lives on an external website rather than in the README
GitHub is for bug reports and feature requests only; support is via Discord
